cardOverview.overviewText: The StarBiz credit card from Federal Bank is a business-focused card tailored for SMEs and entrepreneurs, offering expense management support, reward benefits on business spends, and global acceptance for both domestic and international transactions.

benefitRows.name: Card Benefits
benefitRows.offer: Linked to OD/CC Account: The Fed StarBiz credit card is linked to the customer's existing Overdraft (OD) or Cash Credit (CC) account with limits up to ₹50 lakhs, providing seamless integration with their business finances.|Daily Usage Limits: Customers can perform transactions up to ₹3 lakhs per day or the available limit on the underlying account, whichever is lower.
